title: Ninja Slushi Deal: Here’s How to Make Yourself a Frozen Coffee Treat to Beat the Summer Heat
summary: No ice needed! Make slushies and other frozen drinks at home — save 15% online.
contentText:

It is hot almost everywhere. Whether you’re reading this from California or Texas, we all feel the heat. Lucky for you, we’ve conjured up a way to keep cool with help from a piece of tech that will craft an icy treat that you can make in the comfort of your very own home.

The Ninja Slushi Professional Frozen Drink Maker whips up frozen goodies in as little as 15 minutes — and you don’t need ice to get the job done. Ninja’s Slushi , which retails for $298 (regularly $349.99) at Walmart , utilizes RapidChill Technology — a two-part system that spins 360 degrees and turns liquids into slushy goodness.

$298 $349.99 15% off

Buy Now at Walmart

For a Frappe, the Ninja Slushi is your go-to. To bring you up to speed, a Frappe is an icy blended coffee drink made extremely popular by coffee chains like Dunkin’ and Starbucks. You can find a ton of Ninja Slushi recipes for Frappes online, but this one comes directly from the test kitchen, so you know it’s good.

For two to three servings, you’ll want one cup of half & half, two cups of black coffee, one teaspoon of vanilla extract and third cup granulated sugar. To make it sweeter, you can swap out the granulated sugar with brown sugar. Mix this delish concoction up and pour it into the vessel.

You’ll then click the Frappe preset, which will start at the default and optimal temperature for ideal texture. However, you can adjust the temperature if the presetting is not cold enough. Once it’s frozen, you’ll wanna serve it up asap topped with whipped cream, caramel and mini-chips.

The Slushi features temperature controls to customize the thickness of your frozen concoctions and five settings: Slush, Spiked Slush, Frappé, Milkshake and Frozen Juice.

If you fancy slushies, margaritas, daiquiris, frappés, frosé  or other frozen drinks, Ninja Slushi should be high on your list of must haves. It keeps drinks frozen for up to 12 hours, making it perfect for summertime parties, gatherings and get-togethers.

And if you’re a music fan, break out the Ninja Slushi for your next dance party, or watch parties for your favorite concert specials, music documentaries and award shows, and to pregame before attending a concert or music festival.
